name: Project Intelligence
purpose: Record honest task-level cost, effort, quality, and token metrics in a durable intelligence ledger and apply estimate-vs-actual variance to calibrate future planning.
inputs: Task ledger location, schema version, and pre-work estimate baseline
Measured run signals: duration, token spend, test counts, review rounds
Historical ledger entries for analogous tasks used in calibration
outputs: Closed ledger entry with estimate-vs-actual metrics and quality signals
Variance report aggregated by complexity class
Calibrated estimate for the next analogous task
stop_conditions: Ledger entry closed, variance computed, and calibration applied with evidence
Historical sample below 5 tasks per class; report uncalibrated with warning
